keep.text: Sabse mehngi EMI kiski hoti hai?
Car ki, ghar ki, ya aapki beemari ki?
Aur sabse important cheez, beemari ki EMI sabse bura part hai, pata hai aap logon ko?
Aur ye kabhi khatam nahi hoti hai.
Car ki EMI aap log 5 saal mein khatam kar doge, ghar ki 20 saal mein khatam kar doge, but beemari ki jo EMI hogi,
wo aap logon ke saath lifetime chalegi,
aur isko khatam karne ke liye
bahut zyada mehnat karni padegi.
Sab log ab is cheez ko overcomplicate kar dete hain. Asli secret ye hai ki health insurance bahut logon ke paas
hain, lekin jab zaroorat padti hai toh kaam hi nahi aata hai.
Kyun nahi aata hai?
Chalo, aap dekhte hain.
India mein 65% medical kharcha out of pocket hota hai,
matlab ki aapki jeb se hota hai.
Monthly jo dawai lete ho aap log, wo

500 se 2000-3000 tak kharch kar dete ho. Quarterly jo blood test hota hai aap logon ka, wo 1500 se 3000 rupaye tak ka ho jaata hai. Doctor ka visit jo hota hai, wo 500-1000 rupaye lekar ke chala jaata hai. Aur agar complications aaye
kidney, heart,
ya aur saari cheezon par,
wahan do se das lakh rupaye instant bill lagta hai aap logon ka.
Aur health insurance
IRDAI
ne 2024 mein rule badal diya tha ek:
pre-existing disease ka waiting period maximum
36 months hai.
Matlab ki agar aapko aaj BP diagnose hota hai,
toh teen saal tak ka insurance cover hoga ye nahi.
Ye trap samajhte ho aap log?
Jab aap healthy ho, insurance lete hi nahi ho,
aur
ab bhi
aisa lagta hai ki abhi toh koi zaroorat hi nahi hai, aur jab aap beemar pad jaate ho toh insurance cover karta hi nahi hai.
Pre-existing hai agar,
jab cover hi nahi hota hai,
tab tak aap logon ka poora kharcha 10 lakh se upar pahunch chuka hota hai.
Middle class ki sabse badi problem yahi hai
ki
ek badi medical emergency aa jaati, aur saari ki saari savings khatam,
saara financial stress ek baar mein upar.
Aur jab jab stress aaya hai logon ko, toh health aur zyada kharab ho gayi hai.
Yaani ki isi ko kehte hain
vicious
cycle.
Toh do cheezein karna bahut zyada important hai: health insurance tab lijiye jab sabse zyada healthy ho aap, pre-existing diagnose hone se pehle.
Waiting period tab tak khatam ho jaana chahiye, count ho jaana chahiye.
Protocols follow karna is very important, taaki beemari aaye na aapko.
Lifestyle ka ek protocol banaaiye.
Nahi aata hai toh mujhse poochhiye.
Comment box mein likhiye LIFESTYLE PROTOCOL, toh main aap logon ko protocol deta hoon. 110 kilo se
85 kilo tak ki journey maine 45 days mein
kar li poori,
bahut saara water fasting karke,
bahut achha khaana kha karke, bahut zyada workout karke.
Kyun kar liya maine? Kyunki main yahan se strong hoon. Agar aap yahan se strong ho,
aap bhi kar loge.
Agar aap jo chaaho wo karna chahte ho,
lagta hai ki kar loge,
toh aap bhi weight lose kar loge, aap bhi saare health protocol ko achhe tareeke se follow kar loge.
Meri wife ka BP
aaj ke time pe ekdam achhe tareeke se controlled hai, mummy ka psoriasis ekdam achhe tareeke se improved hai, aur doctor ka jo bill hai na,
wo poora ka poora covered hota hai
mere health insurance se.
Toh ye jaan lijiye doston, ki beemari ka paisa sabse mehnga paisa hai,
aur prevention sabse sasta investment hai.
Toh mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai.
